topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: To ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links, we propose integrating Phased-Array Antennas with Adaptive Beamforming. This design dynamically adjusts array configuration, element spacing, and phasing in real-time to mitigate rapidly fluctuating frequency selective fading and Rician distributed fading caused by high aircraft velocity. The use of CoMP techniques, such as joint transmission and reception between multiple aircraft, can further improve robustness by mitigating pilot contamination. Real-Time Channel State Information (CSI) estimation can be integrated with Phased-Array Antennas and Adaptive Beamforming to enable more accurate prediction of channel conditions, allowing for even more precise adjustments to array configuration and phasing.
reference_context: Aeronautical Ad-Hoc Networking for the Internet Above the Clouds highlights the challenges in establishing stable connectivity among high-speed aircraft due to their dynamic nature and large geographic distribution. Beam-Space Multiplexing Practice, Theory, and Trends emphasizes the importance of designing dynamic beamforming schemes to mitigate spatial non-stationary channel properties.
